nodes.label: ERP Master Documentation (All-in-One)
nodes.rationale: Convenience combined copy of the numbered specifications 00-32 for a single-store Palestinian home-appliance ERP.

nodes.label: Single-Store Appliance ERP (Palestine)
nodes.rationale: Intentionally single-store: not multi-company, not multi-branch; combines retail, serial inventory, installments, checks, Palestinian VAT and audit.

nodes.label: MySQL 8+ / InnoDB
nodes.rationale: MySQL is the only relational DB; utf8mb4, foreign keys and purposeful indexes mandatory.

nodes.label: Laravel Queue (database driver)
nodes.rationale: Queue stored in MySQL (QUEUE_CONNECTION=database) because Redis is excluded; suitable for single-store volume, optimize with separate workers/queue names before reconsidering.

nodes.label: Excluded: Docker, Redis, PostgreSQL, Multi-company/Multi-branch, E-commerce
nodes.rationale: Scope kept to what serves one physical shop; traditional deployment and MySQL-only infrastructure.

nodes.label: Accounting as Source of Financial Truth
nodes.rationale: Sales and payments post double-entry journals; accounting correctness outranks UI convenience.

nodes.label: Movement-Ledger Based Inventory
nodes.rationale: Quantities derive from immutable stock movements, never arbitrary quantity edits (no direct products.quantity edits).

nodes.label: Installment Is a Receivable Contract, Not a Payment Method
nodes.rationale: Cash/check/bank payments settle installments; the contract only defines collection timing of an AR balance.

nodes.label: Check as Financial Instrument with Lifecycle
nodes.rationale: A check is not a string on a payment row; it has custody, due date and collection states (reinforced by PMA ECC/returned-check practice).

nodes.label: Posted Documents Never Deleted (Reversal/Credit Flows)
nodes.rationale: Posted invoices/entries cannot be hard-deleted or silently edited; corrections use credit note, reversal or approved adjustment with audit reason.

nodes.label: Configuration Over Hard-Coding
nodes.rationale: VAT, accounts, sequences, credit rules, installment policies and fiscal settings are configurable; accounting ambiguity becomes a configurable policy/mapping.

nodes.label: MVP vs Full ERP Phasing
nodes.rationale: First production release must already be financially coherent; HR/payroll follows after the financial core stabilizes.

nodes.label: Decimal Money and Quantities (Never Floating Point)
nodes.rationale: DECIMAL(18,4) money/quantity, DECIMAL(18,8) rates; API serializes money as strings to avoid JS float precision issues.

nodes.label: Laravel Modular Monolith
nodes.rationale: One deployable backend with strong domain boundaries: transactional integrity and simpler ops than microservices, extractable later if needed.

nodes.label: Posting Architecture (draft -> approved -> posted -> reversed)
nodes.rationale: Dedicated posting actions lock source, validate config/stock, open a MySQL transaction, create movements and a balanced journal, audit, commit, then dispatch after-commit jobs.

nodes.label: Logical Queue Names (default, reports, exports, notifications, maintenance)
Transaction Boundaries (core posting never queued)
nodes.rationale: Sale, payment, check receipt and posting complete transactionally in the request; only heavy side effects are queued after commit.

nodes.label: File/Document Storage (metadata in DB, binaries on disk)
nodes.rationale: Local filesystem initially behind an abstraction allowing later S3-compatible migration; no large binaries in MySQL.

nodes.label: Idempotency Keys for Critical Writes
nodes.rationale: Payment receipt, check transitions, invoice/return posting accept Idempotency-Key; duplicates return the original result instead of duplicating money/stock movement.

nodes.label: Domain Exceptions with Machine Codes (Error Contract)
nodes.rationale: User-safe Arabic/English messages plus stable machine codes (e.g. CHECK_INVALID_TRANSITION); never expose SQL errors or stack traces.

nodes.label: Atomic Document Number Sequences
nodes.rationale: Configurable per document type; generation must be atomic under concurrency (row locks).

nodes.label: Opening Balances via Opening Journal
nodes.rationale: Customer AR, supplier AP, cash/bank and existing checks migrate through controlled opening-balance journals, not ad-hoc edits; opening stock reconciles to Inventory GL.

nodes.label: Concurrency Locks (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE / lockForUpdate)
nodes.rationale: Used for sequences, limited-serial stock posting, payment allocation and check state moves where a double transition could occur.

nodes.label: Effective-Dated VAT Tax Codes
nodes.rationale: Tax-code table with effective dates instead of a hard-coded percentage; historic invoices never recalculate when the configured rate changes.

nodes.label: Period Closing (Open / Soft Closed / Locked)
nodes.rationale: Locked periods allow no alteration; corrections occur in a later open period via reversal/adjustment.

nodes.label: Currency Handling (ILS base; USD/JOD transactions)
nodes.rationale: Store transaction currency, foreign amount, rate and base amount on every posting; never overwrite old rates.

nodes.label: Sales Recognition at Delivery
nodes.rationale: Installment collection timing must not postpone the original sale posting.

nodes.label: Moving Weighted Average Costing
nodes.rationale: Preferred valuation unless accountant chooses FIFO; serialized units preserve actual acquisition cost for margin traceability.

nodes.label: Control Accounts Reject Manual Journals
nodes.rationale: AR, AP, Inventory, VAT and check control accounts normally reject manual lines to prevent subledger/GL divergence.

nodes.label: Explicit Payment Allocation
nodes.rationale: Payments allocate to selected installments or oldest-due-first; explicit allocation records are stored, never inferred later from totals.

nodes.label: Installment Rescheduling (versioned, never overwrite)
nodes.rationale: Snapshot old schedule, require approval, create a new version, preserve paid allocations and link superseded rows.

nodes.label: Overdue Logic and Aging Buckets
nodes.rationale: Nightly scheduler derives aging buckets/reminders; overdue is collection/risk state and does not mutate accounting.

nodes.label: Customer Credit Policy / Credit Decision Rule Engine
nodes.rationale: Evaluates AR, financed balance, overdue, bounced checks, limits and risk flag; returns pass/warn/block with recorded owner override.

nodes.label: Check Accounting Lifecycle (configurable accounts)
nodes.rationale: Accepted: Dr PDC Receivable / Cr AR; deposit: Dr Under Collection; clearing: Dr Bank; bounce: Dr AR. Mappings configurable because accountants differ on when to credit AR.

nodes.label: Internal Stock Locations (not branches)
nodes.rationale: Showroom, warehouse, reserved, returns inspection, damaged/open box, warranty; they require no branch accounting.

nodes.label: Negative Stock Prohibited by Default
nodes.rationale: Serialized products can never be sold without an actual available serial.

nodes.label: Returns Disposition via Inspection
nodes.rationale: Customer returns are not automatically returned to sellable stock.

nodes.label: Procurement Flow (PO -> Goods Receipt -> Supplier Invoice -> AP -> Payment)
Purchasing Controls (duplicate invoice detection, price variance)
Exchange as Return + New Sale
nodes.rationale: No opaque inventory swaps that bypass accounting.

nodes.label: Async Report Export Pattern
nodes.rationale: Heavy reports run via database-queue jobs with status polling so they do not exhaust request timeout/memory.

nodes.label: Backend-Authoritative Authorization
nodes.rationale: Frontend hidden buttons are convenience only; every endpoint declares policy/permission requirements.

nodes.label: Main Sidebar Information Architecture (no branch menu)
Approval Bound to Exact Payload/Version
nodes.rationale: Approval must not merely unlock a button; the subsequent action verifies the approved payload/hash so numbers cannot change after approval.

nodes.label: Operational Reports (sales, inventory, installment, check, supplier)
Accounting Reports (Trial Balance, GL, P&L, Balance Sheet)
Restore Testing
nodes.rationale: A backup is not valid until restoration is tested and journal/AR/AP reconciliation verified.

nodes.label: Caching Without Redis (file/database cache)
nodes.rationale: Cache only low-risk reference data; never a correctness requirement; avoid caching changing financial balances.

nodes.label: Idempotent Job Design
nodes.rationale: Jobs carry IDs not model graphs, refetch data, define tries/backoff/timeout and use afterCommit().

nodes.label: Phase Gate Implementation Rule
nodes.rationale: Do not begin a later financial domain before preceding ledger/posting invariants are stable; remain deployable after each phase.

nodes.label: Reconciliation Principle (source -> subledger -> JE -> GL -> report)
Codex / AI Coding Agent Implementation Prompt
Palestinian VAT Decision by Law No. 26/2024 (amended No. 11/2026)
Thin Controllers + Explicit Action Classes
nodes.rationale: Controllers do authorization/request -> action -> resource; complex state changes live in Actions named verb+noun; avoid over-engineered repositories.

nodes.label: Production Gate
nodes.rationale: No go-live with failing reconciliation tests, untested restore, or unresolved duplicated-posting risk.

nodes.label: Data Migration and Go-Live
nodes.rationale: Migrate only validated master/opening data, not years of possibly corrupt history; avoid fake historical invoices.

hyperedges.label: Check Settlement Lifecycle (state, accounting, history, deposit)
